scope: Any year · under 20k miles · clean title · nationwide
title: What Each Car Has Been Through
lead: 10 600LT Spiders listed under 20k miles. 9 ranked; 8 CARFAX reports read line by line, 1 with no report to read.
takeaway: My two cents: no 600LT Spider is under the $225k cap today. They sell for $195k to $225k and dealers ask $235k to $295k. Open at $225k on the purple HyperCars car (best history, $316,027 MSRP) and the 1 of 1 car (closest at $239,998, cut $5,000 Nov 11), and let them come to you. Newest: Buy With Berk purple car, $265,449, $40,449 over the cap, no CARFAX and a possible 2023 salvage auction. Ranked last until the full report is in.
shift: West State Motorsport 2020 Yellow, 14,601 mi, $259,700: 4 owners, 3 service records. Rocky's Ultimate Garage 2020 Chicane Grey, 13,850 mi, $295,000, Senna seats: only a paid CARFAX, not read
sources: Listings and full CARFAX reports from carfax.com dealer listings and dealer CARFAX links, read Nov 7, 2026. Sold results from classic.com and Cars & Bids via Codex, Nov 7. Days listed from CARFAX first-seen dates. Window stickers and option lists: every dealer site checked VIN by VIN Nov 7 (iPacket, documents, description); a card says "Dealer site: no sticker" only after that check. Buy With Berk car: no CARFAX obtainable (404, paid only); options and history from Chicago Motor Cars' 2023 listing of the same VIN and auction-reseller pages, CarGurus listing and days on market.

cars.verdict: Best spec here: MSO Clubsport Pack and a $309,550 sticker. Four owners. McKay, Nov 7: no service records 2024-26, but West State did a full inspection, road test and service. Out-the-door sheet: $259,700 + doc $200 + license $1,749 + Northwest Protection $2,394 + enclosed transport to Irvine $2,500 + tax $20,571 = $287,114. No discount. $34,700 over the $225k cap; their own 44k-mile 600LT sold for $230k. Nov 7 evening: McKay dropped all add-ons (about $284,500 out the door) and asked for our number with a deposit. Nov 7 8:19 PM: offered $245,000 + registration and tax, Qazi covers transport, max; trade 2021 Turbo S at $225,000 (build sheet sent).

tl: Chicago Motor Cars (IL) lists it at 6,760 mi: MSO Lantana Purple, $56,677 of options, CARFAX shows 1 owner
Auction resellers (carfast.express, plc.ua) list this VIN at 6,760 mi, Rockford; carfast tags it salvage. Not verified: lot page blocked, title shows clean today
Now 5 previous owners, so 4 more in about 3.5 years
Buy With Berk lists it at 13,205 mi, $265,449 with all fees
No CARFAX on Berk's site, Autotrader or CarGurus (AutoCheck only, paid). iPacket has no record
Price cut $10,000 to $255,449 with all fees
cars.verdict: $30,449 over the $225k cap at $255,449 (fees included), after a $10k cut Nov 14. Best-optioned purple car here, with over $56k of factory options (MSO paint, louvers, Senna seats, lift). But no CARFAX could be pulled, there are 5 owners (1 in Apr 2023), and an auction reseller tags this VIN salvage in May 2023 at 6,760 mi while AutoCheck says clean title. Cars & Bids and BaT comps top out at $225k. Do not offer until Berk sends the full CARFAX and title history; then $225k at most.
